title: Plenora interoperability assignment vector v1
description: Decision 0022 rules 2 and 3: fresh field IDs are canonical decimals, unique within a schema and identical across surfaces reading the same operation on the same store.

surface_outputs.description: Actual readings of the final operation on the same store after this chain's single write. Keys identify distinct surfaces. All outputs must agree, including fresh IDs; these sample IDs prescribe no universal assignment.

assigned_field_ids.description: Zero-based positions of unchanged fields without incoming IDs. Expected metadata omits these IDs; actual output must assign canonical decimal IDs.
